slots.purpose: The temperature drop. The first physical encounter with the forest, and the single frame that must make someone feel cooler.
slots.caption: path, 9 m, bearing 084°
search: rainforest path under canopy dappled light
jungle trail humid tropical forest floor
slots.wrongIf: boardwalk with rope handrails; resort signage; raked gravel; visible sun; palms in rows

slots.purpose: Rule III felt rather than diagrammed. The section explains the rule; a photograph would let someone stand in it.

search: forest path night low level lighting
jungle at night warm ground light long exposure
dark forest path ankle height light

_sourcingRules: Return to the Stage 7 Image Bible and its four-gate rejection checklist. Free/zero-cost sources only. No AI-generated photography.
Source in the locked priority order. Every candidate competes against the drawing currently holding that position.

A photograph is not automatically an improvement because it is a photograph. Introduce it only if it materially improves sensation, desire, atmosphere or physical presence while staying inside the photographic world.
Do not lower the rejection standard to fill all slots. One exceptional photograph is preferable to six merely acceptable ones.
A slot with no approved source renders nothing: no placeholder box, no fake caption, no artificial whitespace.
